facts.fact: The finance minister told the National Assembly that as of March 2026, 113 service providers were licensed to operate payment system services, with the Bank of Tanzania licensing new players.
facts.system: Bank of Tanzania payment provider licensing

facts.fact: The Bank of Tanzania capped the maximum cost of single transactions in the Tanzania Automated Clearing House and the instant payment system at 2,000/- in 2024 and 2025, with a focus on the Tanzania Instant Payment System (TIPS).
The finance minister said fees on interoperability transfers between wallets and bank accounts are capped at 5,000/- for amounts above 500,000/-, with a tiered guided cost limit for smaller amounts.

TZA.note: No government payment to people stated.
No survey share of adults stated.

facts.fact: The finance minister said the Bank of Tanzania has a strategy to keep mobile money services affordable, with 113 payment service providers licensed as of March 2026.
The government reduced the cost of interoperability transfers, moving funds from bank accounts to mobile phone wallets or vice versa, with fees capped at 5,000/- above 500,000/-.

TZA.note: No tax or fee payment stated.
